title: Mejor al rato: el asesor que nunca actualiza el CRM (Serie Sala de Juntas, video 2)

ia.dice: ¡Ahhh! Soy asesor inmobiliario, no secretario. ¿Otra vez anotar lo de este lead? Mejor al rato.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Warm daylight in a busy modern real estate agency office with desks and property posters. Toño, a stocky Mexican real estate agent in his late twenties with big curly hair, a thick beard, sunglasses pushed up on his head, a tight light-blue polo shirt with a real estate agency lanyard and a flashy gold watch, sits at his desk, just hangs up a phone call, looks at his laptop showing an empty CRM form, rolls his eyes, leans back in his chair and lazily pushes the laptop lid half closed while saying in Mexican Spanish, fast and annoyed: "¡Ahhh! Soy asesor inmobiliario, no secretario. ¿Otra vez anotar lo de este lead? Mejor al rato." Medium shot, slight push-in. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, office ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: A ver… ¿con qué lead hablé hoy? ¿A quién le prometí la visita? ¿Y este quién es?
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Night, the same real estate agency office is empty and dark, only a desk lamp on. Toño, a stocky Mexican real estate agent in his late twenties with big curly hair, a thick beard, sunglasses pushed up on his head, a tight light-blue polo shirt with a real estate agency lanyard and a flashy gold watch, sits at his desk covered in messy sticky notes, scrolls his phone confused, scratches his head and squints at the screen while saying in Mexican Spanish, fast and worried: "A ver… ¿con qué lead hablé hoy? ¿A quién le prometí la visita? ¿Y este quién es?" Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, quiet office hum. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

scenes.text: Así pasa en casi todas las inmobiliarias: el asesor deja el CRM para más tarde, y en la noche ya no se acuerda con qué lead habló.
Lead Master se conecta al WhatsApp y a las llamadas de tus asesores y vendedores, y en automático te dice qué pasó con cada lead. Todos los días te llega el reporte, sin que nadie llene nada.
